newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end on high after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end on high after U.S. data.

text.p: 1615 GMT - Portuguese share indexes ended at new year highs in upbeat trading, stimulated by better-than-expected U.S. indicators and end-of-month buying.
*PSI20 May futures were up 65 points at 6,254.
*Dealers said foreign markets would set the tone tomorrow but they expected a final flurry of buying before the May Day holiday on Thursday.

*Cement company Cimpor rose 66 escudos to finish at 3,698 with 881,592 shares traded, buoyed by good prospects for the building sector and its forthcoming dividend payment. One trader said a single foreign investor had been buying strongly.
*Sonae Industria closed up 40 at 1,390 on volume of 534,849.
*BCP shed 3 esc to end at 2,624 with 387,921 shares traded.
